stakeholders across cyber security, infrastructure, and network domains to ensure alignment on architecture, data sources, and deployment approach- Evaluating the reuse and integration of existing network telemetry and sensor data to optimize cost, complexity, and time-to-value- Developing and documenting a target operating model for network-based threat detection and response within cyber security operations- Identifying and managing key project risks, including performance impact, integration complexity, resource constraints, and data protection requirements- Preparing management-ready recommendations, including solution comparison, risk assessment, and roadmap towards implementation and operationalizationQualifications- Academic Degree in a related field or capabilities.- Strong understanding of network-based threat detection and response principles, including behavioral analytics and anomaly detection approaches.- Practical knowledge of enterprise environments and related platforms, including monitoring, alerting, and incident handling processes.- Demonstrated ability to design and execute structured evaluation processes and proof of concepts with clear success criteria.- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into business-relevant recommendations.- Solid understanding of compliance, governance, and data protection requirements in cyber security contexts- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)Advantageous- Experience in integrating detection and process engineering or validation experience in a continuous manufacturing environment 10+ years.- Industry Focus: Strong preference for backgrounds in plastics extrusion, polymer film processing,
